payload.summary: Summary: Nirva Labs, a San Francisco startup founded by former Meta executives, has raised $25 million in a Series A round to develop an AI-enabled titanium pendant focused on luxury jewelry. The company aims to merge high-end aesthetics with wearable AI, targeting consumer use cases where voice-activated assistance and AI recommendations are integrated into fashion jewelry.
